study.name: Comparative Study A vs B – Example
study.description:
Comparative study (A vs B)

A within-subjects comparison of two variants. Each participant experiences both Variant A and Variant B; the order of the two variants is counterbalanced by placing them inside a block, so roughly half of the participants see A first and half see B first.

Replace the survey and variant URLs below with your own.
study.consent:
Consent

Participation is voluntary and you may stop at any time. Your interaction data and questionnaire responses are collected and stored pseudonymously and used for research purposes only.

By continuing you confirm that you are at least 18 years old and agree to take part.

text.title: Welcome
text.body:
Welcome

Thank you for taking part. You will use two versions of the same system and answer a short questionnaire after each.

text.title: Thank you
text.body:
Thank you

That's the end of the study. Thank you for comparing both versions!
